source.behavior: Open the selected site's WordPress Users manager, load authoritative WordPress users for that owned site, and render deterministic loading, failure, empty, and live-data states without synthesizing demo rows.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The explicit tenant/site source route authorizes tenant.view and sites.view, resolves the site under TenantContext, binds the owned site in canonical_site_id, and redirects to the existing real React WordPress Users workspace. Tenant context publishes the exact site-scoped users API; ResourceContent performs the authoritative read and provides loading, error, empty, retry, pagination, and live-data rendering.

authorization.guest_semantics: authentication middleware blocks the tenant-owned route before render
authorization.direct_id_semantics: the numeric site ID is resolved through the active tenant-scoped Site model before redirect or WordPress access

tenant_isolation.server_derived_ownership: TenantContext is established from the authenticated active membership; the route tenant slug and Site global scope prevent cross-tenant site substitution.
tenant_isolation.idor_proof: Focused acceptance proves an Alpha user cannot open Beta's site through either an Alpha route with Beta's site ID or a direct Beta tenant route, and the authoritative users API also returns 404 before WordPress access.

wordpress_boundary.transport: Native WordPress REST through the existing NativeWordPressRestPath
wordpress_boundary.credentials: server-side SiteCredential only; credentials are never rendered into the browser context
wordpress_boundary.remote_read: GET WordPress /wp-json/wp/v2/users with server-owned site credentials and page/search/role query
wordpress_boundary.connector_requirement: No new Connector requirement is introduced by this route operation.
wordpress_boundary.failure_semantics: WordPress/API failures are surfaced through the existing API error path and React QueryError; no local success or demo rows are fabricated.

rendering_semantics.loading: ResourceContent returns LoadingState while the authoritative query is pending.
rendering_semantics.error: ResourceContent renders QueryError with retry on authoritative read failure.
rendering_semantics.empty: An empty server collection renders the explicit empty state and states that sample rows are not synthesized.
rendering_semantics.success: Only rows returned by the real site-scoped users API are passed to DataTable.
rendering_semantics.refresh_and_pagination: Existing ResourceContent refetch/pagination semantics remain authoritative and side-effect free for this GET operation.

mutation_boundary.selected_operation: GET/read route only; no CSRF-bearing mutation is introduced.
mutation_boundary.existing_save_operation: AIMW-BILL-D307963B59 remains the separate authoritative WordPress user create/update mutation.
mutation_boundary.existing_working_state_operation: AIMW-CONT-346657AD9D remains the separate Save/Saving duplicate-submit control.

terminality.basis: The canonical site WordPress Users route is now explicit, operation-bound, permission-guarded and tenant-scoped; it binds only an owned site, opens the existing real Laravel/React Users workspace, and reads authoritative WordPress state through the existing server-side site users API with truthful loading/error/empty behavior.
